title: Why the Fairmont San Francisco Is SO Expensive #luxuryhotels #sanfrancisco
description:
Here's a quick introduction to the Fairmont San Francisco Hotel, based on recent traveler feedback online, making this a useful Fairmont hotel review. This luxury hotel, located on nob Hill, offers beautiful views and a great location for San Francisco travel. While some rooms might feel dated and service can be inconsistent, it's an iconic part of the city's hospitality landscape.
